title.zh: 福卢伊 · 帷幕蓄力与拼刀
title.en: Fufu / Lucia / Yidhari · Veil charge and clashes

summary.zh: 本站据作者与固定机制整理：福福后台击破、卢西娅开梦境，伊德海莉按出招或失衡选择追击。非逐帧原轴。
summary.en: DUKE synthesis of authored methods and fixed mechanics: Fufu provides off-field Daze, Lucia Dream, and Yidhari adapts to attacks/Stun. Not an authored frame timeline.

conditions.zh: 循环站位橘福福→卢西娅→伊德海莉；伊德海莉为主攻。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Ju Fufu → Lucia → Yidhari, with Yidhari as attacker.

conditions.zh: 卢西娅帷幕不会直接解锁伊德海莉终结技；伊德海莉仍须亲自消耗喧响开启帷幕。
conditions.en: Lucia’s Veil does not directly unlock Yidhari’s Ultimate; Yidhari must spend her own Decibels to open it.

conditions.zh: 基础路线0影、无专武可用；低血量增益不代表无敌，不强求硬吃攻击。
conditions.en: The base route works at M0 without signature engines; low-HP bonuses do not grant invulnerability.

conditions.zh: 旧版本作者手法已对照固定3.3基础机制；不沿用旧伤害排名、固定秒轴或潜能觉醒变招。
conditions.en: Older authored methods are checked against fixed 3.3 base mechanics; old rankings, fixed rotations and Awakening variants are excluded.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 福卢伊站位与蓄力衔接（2.3）
label.en: Little Orange · Yidhari team order and charged combos (2.3)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 卢西娅梦境与快支（2.3）
label.en: Little Orange · Lucia Dream and Quick Assist (2.3)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 橘福福后台循环（2.0）
label.en: Little Orange · Ju Fufu off-field loop (2.0)

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 建立后台辅助，再让伊德海莉站场。
objective.en: Establish off-field support, then field Yidhari.

title.zh: 福福补威风，交给卢西娅
title.en: Fufu builds Might, then hands over to Lucia

input.zh: 普通切福福；强化特殊技后普通切卢西娅
input.en: Switch normally to Fufu; EX Special, then switch normally to Lucia

trigger.zh: 开局或威风／虎啸需要补充，且强化特殊技可用。
trigger.en: Opening or Might/Tiger Roar needs a refresh, and EX Special is available.

complete.zh: 确认增加80威风、3威势；退场后仍需虎威命中及至少100威风才触发后台连携。
complete.en: Confirm 80 Might and 3 Momentum; the off-field Chain still requires Hu Wei to hit with at least 100 Might.

reason.zh: 为站场输出准备后台击破；一次强化特殊技不等于虎啸已经生效。
reason.en: Prepare off-field Daze for the attacker; one EX Special does not prove Tiger Roar is active.

fallback.zh: 资源已够则省略EX；若福福已在前台，仍普通切卢西娅。能量不足不空等。
fallback.en: Skip EX if stocked; if Fufu is already on field, still switch normally to Lucia. Do not wait idle for energy.

signal.zh: 完成招式后普通切卢西娅。
signal.en: After the attack, switch normally to Lucia.

title.zh: 卢西娅强化特殊技接普攻第五段
title.en: Lucia EX Special into Basic hit five

input.zh: 强化特殊技 → 点按普攻直达第五段
input.en: EX Special → tap Basic for hit five

trigger.zh: 开局或梦境耗尽需要重建；若只是延长帷幕，核对当前梦境与能量。
trigger.en: Opening or Dream has run out; for a Veil extension, check current Dream and energy.

complete.zh: 核对梦境、帷幕和破暗；童谣须真实触发招式升级或追加攻击，不把进梦自动当成全增益。
complete.en: Check Dream, Veil and Darkbreaker; Nursery Rhyme requires a real skill upgrade or Aftershock, not merely entering Dream.

reason.zh: 未进梦时EX回60、普五回40；开局已有60时EX可先进梦，再用普五升级。
reason.en: Outside Dream, EX grants 60 and hit five grants 40; with the initial 60, EX can enter Dream before hit five upgrades.

fallback.zh: 已有覆盖可省略刷新，但卢西娅在前台时仍交给主攻；没有真实快支就普通切人，跳过下一快支事件。
fallback.en: Skip an unnecessary refresh, but still return to the attacker if Lucia is on field. Without a real assist prompt, switch normally and skip the next assist event.

signal.zh: 仅在真实快支提示出现时接下一位主攻；否则普通切人。
signal.en: Take the next-slot attacker only through a real Quick Assist prompt; otherwise switch normally.

input.zh: 按目标角色快支提示入场
input.en: Accept the intended attacker’s Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 卢西娅进梦或终结技命中触发提示，且下一位为当前主攻。
trigger.en: Lucia entering Dream or landing Ultimate has produced a prompt, and the attacker is next in order.

complete.zh: 完成实际快支，重新查看自身资源和辅助状态。
complete.en: Complete the actual assist and recheck personal resources and support states.

reason.zh: 保持卢西娅→主攻的循环站位，使支援直接到输出角色。
reason.en: Keep Lucia immediately before the attacker so the assist reaches the damage dealer.

fallback.zh: 已通过普通换人入场就跳过，不补按并虚算一次快支。
fallback.en: Skip if already on field through a normal switch; do not invent an assist.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.zh: 蓄力起手，按血量和敌人动作分支
title.en: Charge, then branch on HP and enemy action

input.zh: 长按普攻蓄力；无拼刀机会时三段松手，旋转中点普攻提前下砸
input.en: Hold Basic to charge; without a clash opportunity release at level three, then tap Basic during the spin to slam early

trigger.zh: 伊德海莉在前台、目标可命中；卢西娅帷幕可加快蓄力。
trigger.en: Yidhari is on field with a hittable target; Lucia’s Veil can accelerate the charge.

complete.zh: 看实际蓄力段数和血量；二／三段终结后可接普攻第三段，命中才回血。
complete.en: Read the real charge level and HP; after a level-two/three finisher, Basic hit three heals only if it lands.

reason.zh: 在没有可靠敌方出招时也能输出并维持血量循环。
reason.en: Provides damage and the HP loop even without a reliable enemy attack to clash.

fallback.zh: 血量危险优先闪避或回血；无敌人攻击不假定触发溯寒，也不靠空蓄力无限回喧响。
fallback.en: Dodge or heal when HP is unsafe; do not assume Surging Cold without an attack or infinite Decibels from charging at the HP floor.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

label.zh: 虎威后台攻击 · 虎啸以实际触发为准
label.en: Hu Wei off-field attacks · confirm actual Tiger Roar activation

prep.zh: 开局EX资源不足就按实际可用动作启动，不预填虎啸或童谣。
prep.en: Start from actual available actions when EX resources are short; do not prefill Tiger Roar or Nursery Rhyme.

label.zh: 循环
label.en: Loop

objective.zh: 辅助按需刷新，拼刀成功再接EX。
objective.en: Refresh support when needed; only follow a successful clash with EX.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.zh: 敌人出招时蓄力接溯寒
title.en: Charge into Surging Cold against an attack

input.zh: 长按普攻 → 点特殊技；保持普攻时也可点闪避
input.en: Hold Basic → tap Special; Dodge while holding Basic is another input

trigger.zh: 蓄力／旋转中确有敌人攻击可相撞，或霜凝千钧格挡后可派生。
trigger.en: An actual enemy attack can clash during charge/spin, or a tentacle block allows the follow-up.

complete.zh: 确认溯寒并升至最高蓄力；单独按出挑飞不等于成功拼刀。
complete.en: Confirm Surging Cold and maximum charge; a launcher alone does not prove a clash.

reason.zh: 利用真实触发缩短蓄力，再衔接极寒重碾。
reason.en: Use the real trigger to shorten charging before Glacial Crush.

fallback.zh: 触发失败或闪能不足，回到普通三段蓄力下砸；不强行按出不存在的EX。
fallback.en: If the trigger fails or Adrenaline is short, use the normal level-three charge/slam instead of forcing an unavailable EX.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

label.zh: 虎威后台攻击 · 虎啸以实际触发为准
label.en: Hu Wei off-field attacks · confirm actual Tiger Roar activation

title.zh: 极寒重碾后接两次下砸
title.en: Glacial Crush into the two follow-up slams

input.zh: 触发后点EX／普攻 → 普攻终结下砸 → 普攻第三段
input.en: After the trigger, tap EX/Basic → Basic finishing slam → Basic hit three

trigger.zh: 已成功溯寒／追碾，且闪能足够；1影追加先按配置分支决定。
trigger.en: Surging Cold/Crushing Pursuit succeeded and Adrenaline suffices; decide on the M1 extension before the finisher.

complete.zh: EX命中结束才回复已损失生命；普三也须命中。溯寒后EX额外回闪能，追碾不套用该回复。
complete.en: EX heals missing HP only after its hit and end; hit three must also connect. Only the Surging Cold route grants the extra Adrenaline refund.

reason.zh: 用连招自回复维持下一轮蓄力；按实际窗口决定能否再打一轮。
reason.en: Use combo healing to sustain the next charge; another loop depends on the actual remaining window.

fallback.zh: 窗口结束立即停止追加；不要默认每轮失衡固定能打两套。
fallback.en: Stop extending when the window ends; do not assume two full combos fit every Stun.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

label.zh: 虎威后台攻击 · 虎啸以实际触发为准

prep.zh: 辅助覆盖足够时省略前三步并保持伊德海莉在场；若已经切到辅助，仍明确普通切回。
prep.en: Skip the first three steps while support covers the window and keep Yidhari on field; if already on a support, switch back explicitly.

label.zh: 爆发
label.en: Burst

objective.zh: 辅助已覆盖，在真实失衡窗口集中下砸。
objective.en: With support active, concentrate slams into the actual Stun window.

title.zh: 有连携窗口时选伊德海莉
title.en: Choose Yidhari in a real Chain window

trigger.zh: 真实连携提示可选她；破暗／虎啸覆盖已核对。
trigger.en: A real Chain prompt offers her; Darkbreaker/Tiger Roar coverage is checked.

complete.zh: 连携末击命中；若喧响达极，核对是否自动消耗并解锁她自己的终结技。
complete.en: Land the final hit; at maximum Decibels check whether they were consumed to unlock her own Ultimate.

reason.zh: 进入输出并检查终结技资格，不把卢西娅的帷幕当作她的消耗记录。
reason.en: Enter the window and verify Ultimate eligibility without substituting Lucia’s Veil for her own activation.

fallback.zh: 没有连携可普通切到伊德海莉，跳过本事件再检查资源。
fallback.en: Without a Chain, switch normally to Yidhari and skip this event before checking resources.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足

title.zh: 本人帷幕解锁后再放终结技
title.en: Use Ultimate after her own Veil unlock

trigger.zh: 伊德海莉本人刚消耗喧响开帷幕，解锁窗口未结束且本次尚未使用。
trigger.en: Yidhari spent her own Decibels to open the Veil, the unlock window remains, and this activation has not been used.

complete.zh: 终结技实际完成；不因帷幕仍在而重复计入。
complete.en: Complete the actual Ultimate; an active Veil does not allow repeated uses of the same activation.

reason.zh: 把已解锁终结技放进合适输出窗口；福福返还按实际发动结算。
reason.en: Fit an unlocked Ultimate into the damage window; Fufu’s refund depends on actual activation.

fallback.zh: 未解锁直接跳到追碾／蓄力，不空等、不把他人的帷幕当就绪。
fallback.en: If locked, proceed to Pursuit/charge without waiting or treating someone else’s Veil as readiness.

title.en: Short charge into Crushing Pursuit during Stun

input.en: Hold Basic → tap Special; Dodge while holding Basic is another input

trigger.zh: 敌人仍失衡且闪能足够，挑飞实际命中。
trigger.en: The target is still Stunned, Adrenaline is sufficient, and the launcher hits.

complete.zh: 确认追碾并升至最高蓄力；失衡结束就不算成功。
complete.en: Confirm Crushing Pursuit and maximum charge; no success is assumed after Stun ends.

label.en: Hu Wei off-field attacks · confirm actual Tiger Roar activation

prep.zh: 失衡结束或闪能不足时转普通蓄力；追加触手有独立冷却，不按每次下砸都触发。
prep.en: After Stun or with low Adrenaline, use normal charges; the extra tentacle has its own cooldown and is not triggered by every slam.

text.zh: 1影：EX后可保持普攻／特殊技，用35闪能放弃本次回复并追加极寒重碾；确认生存与资源，再接下砸收尾。
text.en: M1: after EX, holding Basic/Special can spend 35 Adrenaline to forgo the current heal and add Glacial Crush; check HP/resources before finishing.

text.zh: 2影：溯寒／追碾成功才启动持续回闪能；仍可能需要普通蓄力等资源。
text.en: M2: successful Surging Cold/Pursuit starts Adrenaline regeneration; normal charging may still be needed.

text.zh: 福福1影开局威风加速启动，仍需后台虎威命中；不是每次切入重新获得。
text.en: Fufu M1 accelerates the opening Might setup but still needs an off-field Hu Wei hit; it does not refill on every switch.

text.zh: 卢西娅1影回音来自招式升级；按真实层数续童谣，不把梦境值或破暗自动视为无限。
text.en: Lucia M1 Echo comes from skill upgrades; refresh Nursery Rhyme using real stacks, without treating Dream or Darkbreaker as infinite.

text.zh: 伊德海莉专武随真实生命降低叠层；不要在未扣血或层数过期时按满层计算。
text.en: Yidhari’s signature stacks on actual HP loss; do not assume full stacks before loss or after expiry.

text.zh: 卢西娅专武在本人开启／延长帷幕时触发；它改善回能，不保证每轮EX必定就绪。
text.en: Lucia’s signature triggers when she activates/extends a Veil; better energy recovery does not guarantee EX readiness each loop.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.福福补威风，交给卢西娅: 强化特殊技结束后切卢西娅
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.卢西娅强化特殊技接普攻第五段: 强化特殊技接普攻第五段
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.主攻接卢西娅快支: 看到主攻快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.蓄力起手，按血量和敌人动作分支: 长按普攻蓄力，按敌人动作分支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.敌人出招时蓄力接溯寒: 长按普攻蓄力，敌人出招时接特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.极寒重碾后接两次下砸: 点强化特殊技或普攻下砸，再接普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.有连携窗口时选伊德海莉: 出现连携时选伊德海莉
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.本人帷幕解锁后再放终结技: 帷幕解锁、终结技可用时再按
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.失衡中短蓄力接追碾: 失衡中短蓄普攻，再接特殊技

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切福福；强化特殊技后普通切卢西娅: 福福在场且能量足够时按强化特殊技，完成动作后普通切卢西娅。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.强化特殊技 → 点按普攻直达第五段: 按强化特殊技，再点一下普攻，直接衔接第五段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按目标角色快支提示入场: 出现指向主攻的快速支援提示时，按对应支援键入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.长按普攻 → 点特殊技；保持普攻时也可点闪避: 保持长按普攻蓄力，敌人出招时点特殊技；保持普攻期间也可点闪避。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.触发后点EX／普攻 → 普攻终结下砸 → 普攻第三段: 成功触发后，点强化特殊技或普攻发动下砸 → 点普攻打最后一下下砸 → 再按普攻接第三段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.连携选择伊德海莉: 出现连携选人时，选择伊德海莉。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按终结技: 自己的终结技解锁且可用时，按终结技。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1051: 长按普攻开始蓄力，看生命与敌人动作决定松手时机；没有真的触发拼刀就不接拼刀后的招式。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.145100003: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技，等斩击命中

105100002: 长按普攻蓄力，不是点三下。普通蓄力路线到第三阶段松开；旋转时可点普攻提前下砸。
Hold Basic to charge, rather than tapping three times. Release at charge level 3 on the full-charge route; tapping Basic during the spin can advance the slam.
105100006: 先长按普攻蓄力；在蓄力或旋转中接特殊技。保持按住普攻时也可点闪避，二选一。
Hold Basic first; link Special during the charge or spin. Tapping Dodge while holding Basic is an alternate input.
105100007: 触发前置且闪能够：点普攻或强化特殊技，二选一。招式发动后另点普攻接下砸；按本路线再点普攻直达第三段。
With the trigger and enough Adrenaline, tap either Basic or EX. After the move, tap Basic separately for the slam, then link Basic hit 3 on this route.
145100003: 先放强化特殊技，再点普攻直接接第五段；前面不用打四下，后面也不用连点五下。
Use EX first, then tap Basic to link directly to hit 5. Do not add four or five preliminary taps.

1051: 走恢复的蓄力路线才长按普攻；按血量和实际上演的敌人动作决定松手，不是要点满三下。
Hold Basic for the charge route. Release according to HP and the enemy’s actual action; do not count three taps.

105100006: Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit
